_⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🟡 Minor_ | _⚡ Quick win_ **Missing date validation may display "Invalid Date".** Unlike `TicketListWidget` (lines 124-126), this component doesn't validate the date before calling `toLocaleDateString()`. Invalid or missing dates will render as "Invalid Date".
Proposed fix ```diff -
{new Date(issue.fields?.created || issue.created).toLocaleDateString()}
+
{(() => { + const createdDate = issue.fields?.created || issue.created; + const isValidDate = createdDate && !isNaN(new Date(createdDate).getTime()); + return isValidDate ? new Date(createdDate).toLocaleDateString() : 'N/A'; + })()}
```

**Fix `RefObject` type to accept `null` for React 19 compatibility.**

This type declaration causes the CI pipeline failure. In React 19, `useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)` returns `RefObject<HTMLInputElement | null>`, which is incompatible with `RefObject<HTMLInputElement>`.



<details>
<summary>🐛 Proposed fix</summary>

```diff

+  jqlInputRef: React.RefObject<HTMLInputElement | null>;
```

_⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🟡 Minor_ | _⚡ Quick win_

**Consider marking view as modified when removing filter badges.**

`handleUpdateFilter` (used by the badge removal X button on line 356) doesn't call `setIsViewModified(true)`, unlike `handleUpdatePendingFilter`. If removing a staged filter should also mark the view as modified, both handlers should be consistent.



<details>
<summary>Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
 const handleUpdateFilter = (key: string, value: string) => {
   jqlFilters.toggleStagingFilter(key, value);
+  setIsViewModified(true);
 };
```
</details>

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

Using `toLocaleDateString()` without a specified locale can cause hydration mismatches in Next.js. The server-side render (SSR) and client-side render (CSR) environments might have different default locales, leading to mismatched HTML.

Specifying a consistent locale (e.g., `'en-US'`) prevents this issue.

```suggestion
                const createdDisplay =
                  createdDate && !isNaN(createdDate.getTime())
                    ? createdDate.toLocaleDateString('en-US')
                    : '';
```

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The `Checkbox` has an empty `onCheckedChange` handler, which breaks keyboard accessibility (e.g., pressing Space/Enter when focused on the checkbox).

To fix this, bind `onCheckedChange` to `handleUpdatePendingFilter` and stop click propagation to prevent double-triggering from the parent `div`'s `onClick` handler.

```suggestion
                          <Checkbox checked={!!jqlFilters.stagingFilters[filter.key]?.includes(opt)} onCheckedChange={() => handleUpdatePendingFilter(filter.key, opt)} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} />
```
